0.original: The Allagan research node is silently awaiting user interaction.

1.original: You learn that a number of rapidly reproducing, monstrous chimeras have escaped from an Allagan research facility. The research node explains that they pose a severe threat to the local environment and must be immediately terminated. Slay two Allagan chimeras.

2.original: You have slain the horrifying abominations. Inform the research node that the immediate risk to the environment has been ameliorated.

3.original: The research node acknowledges your work and confirms that the threat to the environment has been mitigated. You learn that all attempts at creating composite life-forms have resulted in dangerous and psychologically unstable creatures, but it does not seem that the Allagan research node has any intention of putting limitations on its research.

48.original: <blip> <blip> Transmission received from composite life-form research facility... <buzzzzzz> ...Congratulations. You have been selected to assist in a research experiment.

49.original: Sensors indicate escape by subjects in test chamber 167-B─accelerated chimera breeding program. Subjects present an extreme risk to the surrounding environment. Recommend immediate termination of associated Allagan chimeras.

50.original: To minimize irreparable damage to the local environment, please immediately terminate two Allagan chimeras.

51.original: <blip> <blip> Extermination of chimeras confirmed. Thank you for your service to the Allagan research program. Your satisfactory performance has been noted.
